title: The Day Before

pre.en: What surprise does Chen get at the end?
pre.zh: 最后 Chen 遇到了什么意外？
options: Tom forgets to bake the cake.
His parents arrive a day early.

intro: 一段对话：Chen 的父母明天第一次来看他，他和室友 Tom 在家里商量怎么准备。读的时候留意两种说将来的方式：Chen 早就打算好的事用 be going to，Tom 听完当场决定、主动帮忙用 will。快结束时 Chen 的妈妈发来一条消息，看看计划赶不赶得上变化。

sentences.zh: 小陈，你看着压力好大啊。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: It's their first visit since I moved in.
sentences.zh: 这是我搬进来以后他们第一次来。

sentences.en: OK. In the morning, I'm going to tidy up the living room and sort out the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，明天上午我打算先把客厅收拾一下，再把厨房整理好。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Then I'm going to pick them up from the airport at three.
sentences.zh: 然后三点去机场接他们。

sentences.en: I'll vacuum the living room — oh, and I'll bake a cake for your mum!
sentences.zh: 客厅的地我来吸——哦对了，我再给你妈烤个蛋糕！

sentences.en: To be honest, I'm a bit nervous.
These days, Mum asks me dozens of questions on the phone.
sentences.zh: 最近我妈一打电话就问我一大堆问题。

sentences.en: I think she wants to find out how I really live.
sentences.zh: 我看她是想摸清楚我平时到底怎么过的。

sentences.en: It's a visit, not an inspection.
sentences.zh: 她是来看你的，又不是来检查的。

sentences.en: When I was a kid, she used to open every cupboard in my room.
sentences.zh: 我小时候，她总要把我房间的柜子挨个打开看一遍。

sentences.en: So yeah, I can't help worrying.
sentences.zh: 所以啊，我就是忍不住担心。

sentences.en: Well, at least the plants are still alive.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好歹那几盆植物还活着。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Then I suppose we have no choice but to buy some real ones.
sentences.zh: 那看来我们只能去买几盆真的了。

sentences.en: We wanted to be here for lunch, but we were running late."
sentences.zh: 本来想赶过来吃午饭的，结果路上耽搁了。」

sentences.en: I thought they were flying tomorrow!
They decided to come over a day early.
sentences.zh: 他们决定提前一天过来。

sentences.en: Well, at least they made it here safely.
sentences.zh: 唉，至少他们平平安安到了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

cards.note: to start living in a new home
cards.tip: move in 后面不直接跟地点；要说搬进哪里用 move into：move into a new flat。搬走是 move out。
cards.example: My new flatmate is moving in next week.

cards.note: to make a place clean and neat by putting things where they belong
cards.tip: 可以说 tidy up the room，也可以说 tidy the room up；代词放中间：tidy it up。英式常用，美式多说 clean up。
cards.example: I need to tidy up my desk before the client visit.

cards.note: to organise something that is untidy, or to deal with a problem
cards.tip: 两个意思：整理（sort out the cupboard）和解决（sort out a problem）；代词放中间：sort it out。英式口语 It's sorted. 就是「搞定了」。
cards.example: Can we sort out the login bug before the demo?

cards.note: to lift something, or to collect something that is waiting for you
烤蛋糕、面包、饼干用 bake；烤肉多用 roast，烧烤是 barbecue。
used before you say what you really think, especially something the listener may not like
to get information about something, often by asking someone or by chance
cards.tip: find 是「找到（东西）」；find out 是「弄清、得知」，后面常接 why / how / that 引出的一句话。
cards.example: Let's find out why the build failed before we change anything.

cards.note: 动词是 inspect；正式用词，多用于官方检查：a safety inspection。
读 /ˈkʌbəd/，p 不发音。英式常用，美式厨房的柜子多说 cabinet。
to be unable to stop yourself doing something
used to say that a bad situation has one good point; not less than
cards.tip: 放句首是「好在」：At least nobody was hurt.；放数字前是「至少」：at least ten people。别和 at last（终于）混。
cards.example: The demo crashed, but at least the client laughed.

cards.note: 也能当名词：made of plastic；plastic bag 塑料袋。
to be forced to do something because there is nothing else you can do
手机调成振动时「嗡嗡」响就用 buzz；铃声响用 ring。
to be later than you planned
cards.tip: 一般只用进行时：I'm running late，不说 I run late；过去说 was running late。running late 是还在路上、要晚了，I'm late 是已经迟到了。
cards.example: Sorry, I'm running late — start the meeting without me.

cards.note: to come to the place where someone is, especially their home
cards.tip: 说「到说话人这边来」，常指来家里；自己去别人那边用 go over。从国外过来也能用：come over from China。
cards.example: Do you want to come over for dinner on Friday?

cards.note: 过去式要加 k：panicked；Don't panic! 是「别慌！」。
to succeed in arriving somewhere, especially in time or after a difficult journey
cards.tip: 后面可以跟地点：make it to the office / make it here；也可以单说 We made it!（赶上了／成功了）。
cards.example: The train was delayed, but I made it to the interview with five minutes to spare.
